tiers.name: Flirtatious
tiers.text: They hand out easy compliments and enjoy the attention that comes back.

tiers.name: Lustful
tiers.text: They chase pleasure openly, and a pretty face can pull them off any road.

tiers.name: Lecher
tiers.text: Their appetites rule them, and they will trade cats, safety, or loyalty for a night's company.

tiers.name: Reserved
tiers.text: They keep to themselves in matters of the heart and turn aside flirtation politely.

tiers.name: Chaste
tiers.text: They hold firm against temptation and think little of those who give in.

tiers.name: Ascetic
tiers.text: They have renounced every comfort of the flesh and live as bare a life as the wasteland allows.

tiers.name: Hearty Eater
tiers.text: They never turn down a second helping and always know where the next meal is coming from.

tiers.name: Gluttonous
tiers.text: They think about food constantly and will spend their last cats on a full belly.

tiers.name: Insatiable
tiers.text: No amount of food satisfies them, and they would eat a squad's rations alone if no one stopped them.

tiers.name: Moderate
tiers.text: They eat and drink in sensible measure and rarely overdo anything.

tiers.name: Temperate
tiers.text: They live on lean rations by choice and frown at waste and excess.

tiers.name: Abstemious
tiers.text: They take only what keeps them standing, and they treat every indulgence as a weakness.

tiers.name: Thrifty
tiers.text: They count every cat and spend few of them.

tiers.name: Greedy
tiers.text: They weigh every favor by what it pays, and they haggle over everything.

tiers.name: Avaricious
tiers.text: They would sell a friend for the right price, and no amount of money is ever enough.

tiers.name: Charitable
tiers.text: They spare a few cats for those worse off when they can.

tiers.name: Generous
tiers.text: They share what they have freely and rarely ask for anything in return.

tiers.name: Munificent
tiers.text: They would give away their last cat to a stranger in need.

tiers.name: Laid-Back
tiers.text: They take their time with any task and see no sense in hurrying.

tiers.name: Lazy
tiers.text: They dodge work wherever they can and let others carry the load.

tiers.name: Indolent
tiers.text: They do nothing they can avoid, and they would rather lose everything than lift a finger.

tiers.name: Conscientious
tiers.text: They finish what they start and keep their gear in good order.

tiers.name: Diligent
tiers.text: They work steadily from dawn to dusk and take pride in a job done right.

tiers.name: Industrious
tiers.text: They cannot rest while any work is left undone, and they drive themselves past exhaustion.

tiers.name: Quick-Tempered
tiers.text: They have a short fuse and snap at small annoyances.

tiers.name: Wrathful
tiers.text: They anger easily and answer insults with threats.

tiers.name: Furious
tiers.text: Their rage boils over at the slightest provocation, and they reach for a weapon before they think.

tiers.name: Composed
tiers.text: They keep a level head when tempers rise around them.

tiers.name: Calm
tiers.text: They stay calm under pressure and rarely raise their voice.

tiers.name: Serene
tiers.text: Nothing shakes them, and they meet threats and disasters with the same quiet face.

tiers.name: Restless
tiers.text: They fidget through long waits and like to keep moving.

tiers.name: Impatient
tiers.text: They hate delay and cut others off to get to the point.

tiers.name: Hasty
tiers.text: They act before anyone else has finished thinking, and they cannot bear to wait for anything.

tiers.name: Tolerant
tiers.text: They hear others out before they answer.

tiers.name: Patient
tiers.text: They wait out trouble calmly and do not rush a decision.

tiers.name: Stoic
tiers.text: They endure hardship and delay without complaint, and they can outlast almost anyone.

tiers.name: Proud
tiers.text: They think well of their own skills and like to hear them praised.

tiers.name: Arrogant
tiers.text: They look down on most people they meet and expect to be deferred to.

tiers.name: Haughty
tiers.text: They hold themselves far above everyone else and treat others as dirt beneath their feet.

tiers.name: Modest
tiers.text: They play down their own deeds and share the credit.

tiers.name: Humble
tiers.text: They make no claims about themselves and treat everyone as an equal.

tiers.name: Self-Effacing
tiers.text: They put themselves last in everything and wave off any praise.

tiers.name: Cunning
tiers.text: They bend the truth when it suits them and keep their real plans to themselves.

tiers.name: Deceitful
tiers.text: They lie easily and say whatever gets them what they want.

tiers.name: Treacherous
tiers.text: They would betray anyone for an advantage, and none of their promises means anything.

tiers.name: Forthright
tiers.text: They say what they mean and dislike being misled.

tiers.name: Honest
tiers.text: They tell the truth even when it costs them.

tiers.name: Candid
tiers.text: They cannot tell a lie, and they speak hard truths without regard for the consequences.

tiers.name: Cautious
tiers.text: They avoid needless risks and like to know the way out of any place.

tiers.name: Craven
tiers.text: They back away from danger and leave the fighting to others.

tiers.name: Cowardly
tiers.text: They flee at the first sign of a threat and would abandon anyone to save themselves.

tiers.name: Daring
tiers.text: They take risks that make others hesitate.

tiers.name: Brave
tiers.text: They stand their ground when others run.

tiers.name: Fearless
tiers.text: Nothing frightens them, not even certain death.

tiers.name: Bashful
tiers.text: They are slow to open up to strangers and keep their words few.

tiers.name: Shy
tiers.text: They avoid company and grow uneasy when a stranger talks to them.

tiers.name: Withdrawn
tiers.text: They shut themselves away from others and say as little as they possibly can.

tiers.name: Sociable
tiers.text: They enjoy company and strike up conversations easily.

tiers.name: Gregarious
tiers.text: They seek out people wherever they go and talk to anyone who will listen.

tiers.name: Effusive
tiers.text: They cannot bear silence or solitude, and they pour out their thoughts to anyone nearby.

tiers.name: Aspiring
tiers.text: They want more from life than what they have now.

tiers.name: Ambitious
tiers.text: They work toward a better position and seize every chance to get ahead.

tiers.name: Driven
tiers.text: They will climb over anyone to get what they want, and no gain is ever enough.

tiers.name: Satisfied
tiers.text: They are satisfied with their lot and see little point in reaching higher.

tiers.name: Content
tiers.text: They like their life as it is and resist any change to it.

tiers.name: Complacent
tiers.text: They have stopped striving entirely and will not stir themselves even when things fall apart around them.

tiers.name: Whimsical
tiers.text: They make decisions on a whim and rarely explain them.

tiers.name: Arbitrary
tiers.text: They judge others by their mood of the moment, and their rulings shift without reason.

tiers.name: Despotic
tiers.text: They treat anyone under them as theirs to punish or reward at will, and they answer to no rule but their own.

tiers.name: Fair
tiers.text: They try to treat people fairly and keep their word on a deal.

tiers.name: Just
tiers.text: They believe wrongs must be answered, and they judge others by the same rules they follow themselves.

tiers.name: Righteous
tiers.text: They cannot let an injustice pass, and they will risk their life to see a wrong put right.

tiers.name: Skeptical
tiers.text: They doubt grand claims and want proof before they believe anything.

tiers.name: Cynical
tiers.text: They expect the worst of people and mock anyone who preaches.

tiers.name: Nihilistic
tiers.text: They believe nothing in this world matters, and they sneer at every hope and every cause.

tiers.name: Devout
tiers.text: Their beliefs guide their days.

tiers.name: Zealous
tiers.text: They hold their beliefs above comfort, and they judge others by them.

tiers.name: Fanatical
tiers.text: They would kill or die for their beliefs, and they treat doubt as betrayal.

tiers.name: Wary
tiers.text: They keep strangers at a distance until those strangers prove themselves.

tiers.name: Paranoid
tiers.text: They suspect a threat in every stranger.

tiers.name: Conspiratorial
tiers.text: They trust no one, and they see a plot behind every kindness.

tiers.name: Open
tiers.text: They give strangers the benefit of the doubt.

tiers.name: Trusting
tiers.text: They believe what they are told and expect others to be honest with them.

tiers.name: Naive
tiers.text: They trust anyone who speaks kindly to them, and they never see a trick coming.

tiers.name: Detached
tiers.text: They keep the troubles of others at arm's length.

tiers.name: Callous
tiers.text: They feel little for the suffering of others and step over it on the road.

tiers.name: Cold-Hearted
tiers.text: They are indifferent to the pain and death around them, and they would leave a dying friend for a few cats.

tiers.name: Kind
tiers.text: They are kind to those in trouble and help when it costs them little.

tiers.name: Compassionate
tiers.text: They feel the suffering of others keenly and go out of their way to ease it.

tiers.name: Saintly
tiers.text: They give everything to help the wretched and the wounded, and they cannot walk past anyone in need.

tiers.name: Cruel
tiers.text: They enjoy seeing others squirm and have a cruel sense of humor.

tiers.name: Sadistic
tiers.text: They take pleasure in the pain of others and look for chances to cause it.

tiers.name: Sociopathic
tiers.text: They feel nothing for anyone, and they hurt others simply because they can.

tiers.name: Resolute
tiers.text: They hold to their decisions and are hard to talk out of them.

tiers.name: Stubborn
tiers.text: They dig in when challenged and rarely admit they are wrong.

tiers.name: Obstinate
tiers.text: They will not change their mind for any argument or proof, even as it leads them to ruin.

tiers.name: Indecisive
tiers.text: They struggle to settle on a choice and often change their plans.

tiers.name: Fickle
tiers.text: Their moods and loyalties shift from one day to the next.

tiers.name: Erratic
tiers.text: They swing from one wild notion to the next, and no promise of theirs lasts the night.

tiers.name: Resentful
tiers.text: They remember every slight and bring it up later.

tiers.name: Vengeful
tiers.text: They hold grudges for years and wait for a chance to pay them back.

tiers.name: Vindictive
tiers.text: They will spend everything they have to destroy anyone who wronged them, however long it takes.

tiers.name: Lenient
tiers.text: They let small wrongs go and do not dwell on them.

tiers.name: Forgiving
tiers.text: They forgive easily and give second chances to those who ask.

tiers.name: Magnanimous
tiers.text: They pardon even betrayal and violence, and they bear no grudge against anyone.

tiers.name: Quirky
tiers.text: They have a few odd habits that others notice and remark on.

tiers.name: Eccentric
tiers.text: They follow strange routines and hold peculiar ideas that set them apart.

tiers.name: Bizarre
tiers.text: Their behavior baffles everyone around them, and they live by a logic only they understand.
